title: Intra-articular Polyacrylamide Hydrogel in Knee Osteoarthritis
brief_summary: The aim of this double-blinded controlled study is to assess clinical efficacy and safety of intra-articular HBISA Endoprosthesis of Synovial Fluid (polyacrylamide hydrogel) in comparison with placebo (0.9% sodium chloride solution) in Kellgren Lawrence radiological grade II-III knee osteoarthritis
